repos_data.description: Free, open-source disk usage analyzer for macOS, Windows and Linux. See what fills your disk, servers (SSH) and cloud storage in an animated sunburst or treemap, and clean it up safely. A DaisyDisk, WizTree and WinDirStat alternative, in native Rust 🦀
Free macOS menu bar app to visualize and clean developer caches (Xcode, node_modules, CocoaPods, SPM, Docker, pip, Cargo). Reclaim disk space instantly.

Free, open-source disk space analyzer for macOS, inspired by WinDirStat. See what's taking up space on your Mac with an interactive treemap and track down large files. Native SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, signed and notarized, fully offline.
See what is eating your Mac's disk on a map you can walk through. Native SwiftUI app in English and Russian.
